messages:
marta: Hey team — the Dedicated capacity panel for acme-corp is showing 0 GPUs after we did the EKS nodegroup swap at 10:30. Customer CS-8421 is complaining about capacity. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dedicated/acme-corp/capacity
kevin: thanks, grabbing dashboard now. any alerts from inventory sync?
obs: noticed a metrics ingestion gap 10:32-10:37. looks like inventory events stopped flowing. query: sum(gpu_nodes) by (cluster) shows 0 for cluster acme-prod during that window.
sam: saw the reconcile job crashlooping after the nodegroup swap — suspect the node labels changed and our mapper failed. quick log: 
```
reconcile-controller error: failed to map node label mapping: missing iam:PassRole permission for nodegroup-auto-swap
panic: runtime error: index out of range
```
kevin: can you paste kubectl get nodes -o wide from the cluster? want to see labels.
marta: pasted below. nodes are there but label key is different after swap: node.k8s.aws/accelerator -> node.kubernetes.io/gpu
```
NAME                           STATUS   ROLES    AGE    VERSION
ip-10-0-12-34.ec2.internal     Ready    <none>   8h     v1.26
ip-10-0-56-78.ec2.internal     Ready    <none>   8h     v1.26
LABELS: node.k8s.aws/accelerator=g4dn node.kubernetes.io/gpu absent
```
olivia: customer is impacted in staging and one production shard. they want ETA on a fix.
kevin: root cause: our inventory mapper expects the old label key node.kubernetes.io/gpu. nodegroup swap used new AMI that sets node.k8s.aws/accelerator. reconcile crashed due to unexpected map entry + missing iam permission reported by sam.
kevin: mitigation: 1) add a tolerant label matcher to inventory service, 2) trigger a full resync, 3) restart reconcile pods. I can push a temporary config change and trigger resync.
sam: opened PR to accept both label keys and added safer nil checks: merged to hotfix branch. I triggered a deploy to staging.
kevin: running emergency resync now: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/sync/inventory?cluster=acme-prod -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inventory-reconciler -n redwood-infra
```
marta: resync triggered, reconcile pods restarted. dashboard shows partial recovery for 2 nodes, still missing gpus on one node. logs show one node still unlabeled due to EC2 metadata timing.
obs: metrics pipeline recovered at 10:42 and ingested node events. there is a short-lived zero count window but now values trending up.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot: deployed inventory-hotfix hotfix/accept-multiple-labels to staging at 1932104720 :rocket:
sam: hotfix merged to main and scheduled for prod canary at 1932104825, will monitor.
olivia: replied to CS-8421 with status, said we have a mitigation applied and are monitoring; asked customer to validate capacity in 15m. :thumbsup:
marta: customer confirmed production shard back to expected GPU count at 10:48. closing immediate incident, will follow up with postmortem on label mapping assumptions.
kevin: follow-ups: add unit test for label variants, update runbook for nodegroup swaps, and verify IAM perms for reconcile controller.
olivia: noted in ticket and set follow-up reminder for postmortem doc.
